notes.title: New publisher, new leaderboards!
notes.content:
Hello there! 

Like other games studios, Last year where hard times for Devs Must Die. Unfortunately the studio is now closed. However, everybody want this game to live on.

TyGAMES and ISART Digital decide to team up, with the agreement of the devs, to make it possible.

First of all, we have made a patch : 

The leaderboards were broken due to the provider shutting down. We've fixed them and the game is now using the Steam leaderboards.
The scores has been adjusted with the help of the dev team


To celebrate we're also putting the game on sale, so now is the best time to get the best times & scores!

Have fun!

notes.title: Skybolt Zack Sale
notes.content:
Heads up skybolters! 

Skybolt Zack is currently on sale with a mega 75% OFF right now for a limited time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/909670/

Skybolt Zack is the result of a unique way of mixing platformer mechanics and colour matching gameplay. Controls are tight and Zack’s ability to rocket punch, dash, focus, change direction when destroying an enemy and more, offers more depth than what meets the eye.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35324897/c75230604ae97d385e6588ed03fd779353ed884b.png

But don't take our word for it! Check out the announcement gameplay Trailer and tonnes of features to get a true feel and understanding of what the game is all about.

[previewyoutube=--X3QwJHwVw;full][/previewyoutube]

FEATURES

 48 frantic challenging levels that can all be completed without putting a foot back on the ground
 Branching routes with different levels of difficulty
 More than 15 environments divided into 5 distinct worlds
 An art style combining 3D assets and digital painted textures with tons of FX and explosions!
 Evolutive soundtrack inspired by famous platformers from the 90’s
 More than a dozen types of robotic enemies for renewed challenges throughout the game
 Dedicated speedrun and score attack modes
 2 different leaderboards: one for the best scores and one for the best times on every level
 Fully customizable controls and colour-blind options
 No boring dialogue! (You’d have skipped them anyway...)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35324897/c19e301cbb92649f63449bd465e6f7cf84e1ee47.jpg

See you out there!

- The Skybolt Zack Team

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 is here! Bug fix and difficulty balancing
notes.content:
Hi there!

Thanks to the feedback we got since release, we update Skybolt Zack today!

We fixed a few bugs concerning achievements:
- The "Perfect!" achievement requires to get a Full Combo 1 time, matching the description.
- "And the World is saved" no longer unlocks when beating the final boss in route B, and actually unlocks when beating it in route A.

Leaderboards:
- Leaderboard shouldn't display in the wrong order anymore.

Difficulty adjustement:
- Zack now starts every level with 4 HP instead of 3, making beating levels and training easier.
- Destroying enemy increase the range faster than before, helping building up range to combo enemies and making some enemies easier to reach.

We hope these tweaks will help and as always, please send us feedback so we can improve the game further!

notes.title: Demo release and crowd scoring contest is on!!! Update: 4th goal reached!
notes.content:
Right before the release, you managed to reach the last goal!!


20 days before the release of the full game, there's a way for you to discover how Skybolt Zack changes platforming rules, and take part in our global crowd scoring campaign to unlock discounts and bonuses before the release!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35324897/64de3b9aa9e084ff173bff05e2cce92c28b02d80.png

To unlock those rewards, it's very simple: simply play the 1st level of the demo (right after Tutorial 1), and check this community page from time to time, we'll take care of the rest!

The first goal was a combined score of 10 000 000 points for a 5% discount on Skybolt Zack during the 1st week of release! It's been reached less than 8 hours after the demo was released!
Here are the details of how the campaign works: 

- We gather all the entries in the leaderboard of the 1st level of the game, level 1-1A.
- We add all those entries and will update the total score daily on Steam's community hub
- When a goal is reached, players unlock a reward for everyone, not just those who played the demo!
- New stretch goals and associated rewards will be revealed as the global score progresses.

See, it works exactly like a crowd funding campaign, except you give points and save money instead of spending it!

Every Steam account can enter one score in the leaderboard, which will be updated every time you improve your score! 

Try to aim for the best ranks and add a lot of points and share the news with your friends so they can add theirs too! Every punched evil robot helps!
